text: Pellham, Nov. 13 — The Pellham Council approved the harbour levy 19 to 6 on Monday night after a brief adjournment and a late tally shift among waterfront district members, people familiar with the matter said. The measure, which raises dock maintenance fees and creates a new cargo lighting fund, was pushed through after Councillor Mara Venn of Ward 4 cast the deciding pro-levy vote in the final roll call. Opponents argued the surcharge would add 3.2% to monthly berth charges, but supporters said it was needed to repair Stormgate Pier and replace aging signal buoys by spring. The levy takes effect Dec. 1, according to a draft notice circulated after the vote.
